scope: Developer-labelled routing fixture. Not a held-out task-completion or energy benchmark.
B_scope: Routing decision only; cloud recommendations do not execute cloud work in this fixture.
A_scope: Not run: requires --cloud-baseline plus configured cloud access
completion_note: Routing labels do not prove task completion. One real system probe is reported separately; use aries-agent-demo for four execution controls.

stats_snapshot.requests_scope: Router invocations, including previews; not distinct completed tasks
stats_snapshot.usage_scope: ARIES-initiated requests in retained events only; excludes other terminal sessions, applications and account-wide usage
stats_snapshot.token_subtotals_note: Measured fields sum available per-request reports only; incomplete coverage is not total consumption. Cached input may be included.
stats_snapshot.savings_note: Requires measured matched all-cloud baseline; not inferred from routing.
